purpose: Current-proof provenance for saved motif readers, timelines, summaries and practice; lifecycle contracts, not classifier accuracy.

historicalEvidence.method: A read-only in-memory loader ran the historical adapter and core at their original relative-import location. Both loader uses were asserted. Synthetic inputs were legally replayed; no owner deck was read.

pairedContracts.method: Identical frozen tests and current adapter171 dependencies. The before run overrides only the resolved mistakeReview.ts module with its saved pre-change bytes, asserts loader use and reports their hash. No nonexistent new helper is imported by the baseline. verification.bulkBoundary: 1,100 stale records with throwing FEN/PV accessors produce no theme counts or practice entries without reading those fields.

contract: The existing exact motifClassifierVersion identifies the complete stored classification. No new persisted version or truth stamp is invented.

Both root arrays are required because every current classifier emits them. Optional timelines may be absent, falling back only to the same valid record's roots; an explicit empty timeline remains empty.
Stale, missing, malformed and future versions abstain. Malformed current arrays reject the entire record and become eligible for existing asynchronous migration.

The existing saved-card schema validates only motif arrays and version. No FEN, PV, engine evaluation or tactical proof is read during validation. Validation is cached by immutable metadata and its version/four array identities.

Root getters, summary counts, practice filters and both Workspace timelines share the gate. Workspace applies repaired same-version records instead of skipping them solely because their version strings match.

Failure or practice-time suspension of background migration cannot resurrect old labels. Successful migration restores genuine current proofs and neutral retained context while preserving SRS, notes and raw lines.
Abstention is not a positional-negative judgment. The nature classifier and tactical core are unchanged by this reader work.
boundaries: The current shared-export score repair was not changed; these readers protect all saved-card origins.
Cache invalidation follows the existing immutable metadata/array update contract; consumers must not mutate cached motif arrays in place.
No synchronous bulk reclassification, owner-store scan/write, service/native/browser operation, deployment, corpus download or generated build was performed for this scoped reader work.

The JSX tests render the actual shared timeline component in jsdom; they do not claim a full running Workspace or installed-device interaction. Workspace wiring is a narrow inspected import/call/merge patch.
Final milestone-wide build, generated-service and exact staged-core checks are separate. Pending checking-ray source work is preserved.
